privacy.scope: Exact configured env key/token/contact values in git-visible tracked and untracked working files. Excludes ignored env/state/dependencies; not Git history, encoded values, unknown secrets or OCR.

notes: Initial broad107-case run passed99; final affected rerun resolved eight failures. Corrections include singular-count wording, separating search-form errors from reader errors and limiting default auto-preview to Papers, plus updated Dataset chip and stale-read fixture assertions.

New targeted acceptance covers title chips on the same text flow, seven aligned paper actions, clear provider/Unpaywall disclosures, disabled DOI/Notes behavior, coverage status and exact duplicate DOI grouping semantics.

Native PDF checks serve an actual valid PDF, assert no iframe sandbox, delay loading, explicit native new tab and no download for the inline response. Publisher attachment headers/browser download preference remain external limitations.
Saved-live review blocked API writes at six widths; provider/model usage remained unchanged. No live retrieval, document request, model call, restart, commit or push was performed.
Detailed video-specific card optimization remains deferred; shared controls apply to both tabs.
